title: Check scripts: split issues into errors and warnings
description:
For CI, will now return error codes only for those issues
that are definitely bugs that will require fixing. i.e.

- if the type is not compatible with the proto_tree_add...() call

- if a TFS is (case-sensitively) identical to a tfs.c entry
